verdict.rationale: Paddle publishes an official Postman collection covering every Billing API operation, so users can 'try the API interactively before writing code'. It also publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec that can be imported into exploration tools like Scalar or Redocly. However, the interactivity comes from external tooling: nothing shows the docs' own API reference offering in-page runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API reference with in-docs runnable examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Paddle Postman collection includes every operation, so you can try the API interactively before writing code.
